title: Saudi Arabian Egg Noodle Dumplings
description: A traditional Arabian twist on a classic dumpling recipe, utilizing egg noodles and spiced fillings.
instructions: Cook egg noodles in boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the spiced Arabian dum mixture and cook until browned.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir well.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Using a spoon, form the mixture into dumpling shapes.
If using dumpling wrappers, place a spoonful of the mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Heat 2 tbsp of ghee or vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the pan and fry until golden brown.
